topic: How to further improve the two forked Pi extensions built in packet 039: pi-cache-optimizer's DeepSeek-guard fork at .pi/extensions/pi-cache-optimizer/, and deep-pi's hardened DeepSeek-direct fork at .pi/extensions/deep-pi/, covering correctness, test coverage, telemetry/observability, cost-economics, and maintainability

noveltyJustification: Four of five findings are line-exact independent corroborations of the parent Tier 1 set; one sharpens the guard mechanism into a concrete test target.
keyQuestions: Which Tier 1/2 findings from the parent synthesis can be independently corroborated or refuted from this lineage's own read of the source?
Which correctness and failure-isolation gaps remain in each fork beyond the already-disclosed set?
answeredQuestions: Which Tier 1/2 findings from the parent synthesis can be independently corroborated or refuted from this lineage's own read of the source?
ruledOut: Enforce ownership split via a shared runtime module

keyFindings.summary: Both forks hardcode identical direct-DeepSeek model ids; no shared source of truth.
deeppi command routes full report exclusively through ctx.ui.notify.
deep-pi resets in-memory telemetry every session_start; no persistent stats file.
recordUsage drops pure-cache-write usage and savings arithmetic omits cacheWrite cost.
cache-optimizer session_start early-return is the exact seam a composition test must assert.

focus: Correctness and test coverage deep dive
noveltyJustification: Two direct corroborations, two sharpened with a new mechanism and a severity correction, and one genuinely new (interior-line staleness).
keyQuestions: Which correctness and failure-isolation gaps remain in each fork beyond the already-disclosed set?
Which high-value boundary, fault-injection, and live-contract tests are missing?
answeredQuestions: Which correctness and failure-isolation gaps remain in each fork beyond the already-disclosed set?
ruledOut: Treat post-rename verification as strict CAS; it detects but cannot prevent the mixed-file state

keyFindings.summary: deep-pi message_end has no stopReason guard; a zero-usage failed attempt flips usageUnavailable permanently.
deep-pi recordUsage trusts unvalidated numeric usage; cache-optimizer validates isFinite.
edit_lines validates only range endpoints; in-place interior changes are silently overwritten.
atomicWriteFile already verifies landed content post-rename; parent TOCTOU severity is overstated for deep-pi.
Both suites omit pure-cache-write, stopReason, NaN/negative, and persistence/restart cases.

noveltyJustification: One finding precisely characterizes a previously-open gap (deep-pi cold-start drop), two corroborate with field-level mechanism and current pricing, one is a concrete persistence design.
keyQuestions: How should both forks expose durable, automation-friendly telemetry without leaking sensitive content?
Which cost claims can be measured honestly, and what does cold-start cache-write behavior require?
answeredQuestions: Which cost claims can be measured honestly, and what does cold-start cache-write behavior require?
ruledOut: Shared single stats file for both extensions
Copy pi-cache-optimizer read-merge-rename persistence into deep-pi verbatim

keyFindings.summary: deep-pi's establishing cache write is entirely invisible; the first request of every session is dropped and flips usageUnavailable.
pi-cache-optimizer structurally can characterize cold-start writes; only the measurement run is missing.
Cache-hit-rate denominators diverge: pco includes cacheWrite in totalInput; deep-pi excludes it.
DeepSeek v4 has no separate write tier; write cost is the cache-miss price, so savings math ignoring writes overstates.
deep-pi stats file should reuse its own atomicWriteFile, not copy pco's racy read-merge-rename.

noveltyJustification: Four findings are new (hot-path digesting, packaging double-break, test-runner blocker, report-command side effect) and one corrects this lineage's own earlier false negative.
keyQuestions: Which high-value boundary, fault-injection, and live-contract tests are missing?
Which maintainability improvements are concrete and evidence-backed beyond provenance drift?
answeredQuestions: Which maintainability improvements are concrete and evidence-backed beyond provenance drift?
Which high-value boundary, fault-injection, and live-contract tests are missing?
ruledOut: Treat the test-runner difference as a non-issue
Change report transport before separating report data from rendering

keyFindings.summary: errorsEnhanced exists in stormbreaker but is un-surfaced; parent f-014 stands, iteration-1 refutation was a false negative.
before_provider_request digests the whole conversation on every request and messageDigests grows unboundedly.
deep-pi benchmark:live is doubly broken: script missing AND files allowlist excludes scripts/.
FakePi harness exists for a composition test but the forks use divergent test runners (node:test+jiti vs vitest).
Read-only deeppi report command mutates telemetry.latestChurn; must be broken by structured-report refactor.
